messages:
Sam (Support): FYI ticket from FinServe (enterprise) — they need streaming completions + function/tool-call streaming where tools emit structured events. They want low tail latency and a clear launch SLA. attaching customer notes...
Oliver (Sales): TL;DR: high $$, will push for priority. They want guaranteed max latency for chat streaming and deterministic event ordering for tool calls. :moneybag:
Sam (Support): Key asks: 1) stream partial structured payloads as they’re generated 2) function call arguments may arrive incrementally (e.g., large list) 3) ability to fallback to non-streaming without breaking contract
Priya (Product): Need concrete acceptance criteria before we promise: what does "partial structured payload" mean? Do they expect JSON fragments, newline-delimited objects, or custom frames? Also confirm protocol (SSE / websocket / HTTP chunked).
Ana (Solutions): They currently use SSE in their webapp. Prefer straight JSON objects per event so frontend can render progressively. Example of desired events:
```
{ "type": "token", "text": "Hello" }
{ "type": "tool_event", "tool": "account_lookup", "body": { "partial": true, "items": [... ] } }
{ "type": "final", "schema": "account_v1", "body": { "id": 123, "balance": 42.0 } }
```
Oliver (Sales): Also asked for per-token cost visibility and audit logs for tool outputs. They have compliance needs.
Maya (Eng-ML): Technical notes from runtime side:
- Streaming already exists for plaintext (chunked). To support structured streaming we need: framing layer + incremental JSON assembly + KV-cache safe streaming for chat + deterministic ordering guarantees for function/tool events.
- Two options:
  1) Emit JSON fragments as text tokens (fast to prototype, client must reassemble). Pros: minimal runtime changes. Cons: brittle for strict schemas.
  2) Introduce typed event frames over SSE/ws where each frame has metadata (type, seq_id, final_flag). Pros: robust; Cons: requires client SDK changes and infra framing work.
Priya (Product): Proposal for scope negotiation:
- MVP (P0): support event-framed SSE for chat completions + function call events with a simple schema. Guarantee: ordered frames, final frame contains full JSON for validation. Docs + migration guide for clients.
- M1 (P1): SDK support (node/python) for automatic reassembly, plus telemetry hooks in Console (per-route streaming latency + token cost).
- M2: Backwards-compat streaming for older clients via text-fragment mode; advanced features like partial schema validation and schema evolution tools.
Sam (Support): Customer is OK with staged rollout. They want to pilot the MVP in a closed beta for 2 customers first.
Oliver (Sales): Recommend pilot + commercial term: 6mo pilot at committed spend. That gives us time to harden.
Maya (Eng-ML): Engineering estimate (rough): MVP framing + server changes = 3 engineer-months; SDK + docs = 1.5 engineer-months; Console metrics + rollout tooling = 1 eng-month. Risks: edge cases with tokenizers splitting JSON tokens, timeouts for long-running tool streams.
DeployBot: New issue created on product/streaming: #PRJ-3921 — streaming-structured-tool-events (link: https://staging.redwood/prj/3921)
Priya (Product): Launch criteria checklist draft:
- API: SSE/ws framing spec published and stable
- Runtime: ordered delivery & final-frame validation passing in 95% of pilot sessions
- SDK: node/python helpers for reassembly published
- Observability: per-route streaming latency + cost visible in Console
- Security/compliance: audit log + KMS-integration for tool outputs tested
Maya (Eng-ML): Quick compatibility snippet for SDKs (how we’ll expose it):
```
client.streamCompletion({ model: 'rwd-gt', mode: 'framed' })
.on('frame', f => { if (f.type === 'tool_event') handleTool(f.body) })
.on('done', final => validateSchema(final))
```
Ana (Solutions): I’ll draft a migration guide for customers and a sample frontend SSE handler.
Priya (Product): Next steps: Priya to make a short PRD (1-pager) with acceptance criteria; Maya to provide a focused tech spike plan; Ana to prepare pilot onboarding checklist; Sam to coordinate with customer for pilot sign-up. Target: have PRD + spike plan by EOW.
Sam (Support): Sounds good — I’ll ping FinServe today and ask for pilot participants and their exact event shapes.
Oliver (Sales): I’ll add the commercial terms to the pilot note. :thumbsup:
Priya (Product): Adding this to roadmap review — will propose prioritization during Friday planning. Thanks all.
